check_relevance: check if an atomic fact is relevant for answering a given prompt using an LLM model
revise_fact: revise an atomic fact to replace vague references with proper entities from the response
main: run the full relevance check and fact revision pipeline on a prompt, response, and atomic fact
check_relevance_SYMBOL: check relevance using the SYMBOL and NOT_SYMBOL constants to classify subject relationships
check_relevance_RELEVANCE_FORMAT: use the RELEVANCE_FORMAT prompt template with few-shot examples to evaluate atomic fact relevance
